visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a shelf with books and a CD case featuring a man in a black hat. The room is dimly lit with a warm yellow glow. (2) A hand holds a smartphone showing a social media video of a street interview. The background is a blurry bedroom. (3) A young man with short dark hair wearing a white T-shirt is sitting on a bed, looking down at his phone screen. (4) An outdoor scene in a park with lush green trees. A man in a red cap and sunglasses is being interviewed by a woman in glasses and a man in a black bucket hat. (5) Close-up of the young man in the white T-shirt as he smiles while watching the phone. (6) Back in the park, the man in the red cap gestures with his hands during the interview. (7) The young man in the white T-shirt appears in the park setting, walking up to the man in the red cap and shaking his hand with a joyful expression.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A cluttered but cozy bedroom with a bed and desk; an outdoor public park with trees, a paved path, and benches.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator speaks with a friendly, professional tone over a low-volume acoustic guitar backing track. (2) A female interviewer asks a question with a bright, curious intonation. (3) A middle-aged male interviewee answers in a relaxed, casual voice with clear articulation. The acoustic background music continues. (4) The interviewee sings or says a catchphrase, which triggers a sudden jump to a loud, upbeat pop song. (5) The pop song features a male vocalist singing with high energy over a driving rhythmic beat. (6) Sound layers of laughing and cheering from multiple voices are added over the music, creating a sense of excitement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the HahaTai street interview channel by showing a relatable viewer's experience. The video combines an interview clip with a scripted encounter to emphasize the brand's catchphrase 'Follow your feelings' (跟著感覺走).

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent use of the channel logo 'HahaTai' and social media handles.

high_inference.freeDescribe: An effective cross-media promotion piece that blurs the line between street reality and scripted comedy.
